name: tree-sitter-sfapex
description: A tree-sitter grammer for Salesforce's Apex, SOQL, and SOSL

scripts.build: npm run build-generate && npm run build-wasm
scripts.build-generate: npm run build-apex && npm run build-soql && npm run build-sosl && npm run build-sflog
scripts.build-wasm: npm run build-apex-wasm && npm run build-soql-wasm && npm run build-sosl-wasm && npm run build-sflog-wasm && npm run build-docs
scripts.build-apex-wasm: cd apex && npx tree-sitter build --wasm && node ../scripts/copyFile.mjs tree-sitter-apex.wasm ../docs/playground/tree-sitter-apex.wasm && node ../scripts/copyFile.mjs tree-sitter-apex.wasm ../bindings/web/tree-sitter-apex.wasm
scripts.build-soql-wasm: cd soql && npx tree-sitter build --wasm && node ../scripts/copyFile.mjs tree-sitter-soql.wasm ../docs/playground/tree-sitter-soql.wasm && node ../scripts/copyFile.mjs tree-sitter-soql.wasm ../bindings/web/tree-sitter-soql.wasm
scripts.build-sosl-wasm: cd sosl && npx tree-sitter build --wasm && node ../scripts/copyFile.mjs tree-sitter-sosl.wasm ../docs/playground/tree-sitter-sosl.wasm && node ../scripts/copyFile.mjs tree-sitter-sosl.wasm ../bindings/web/tree-sitter-sosl.wasm
scripts.build-sflog-wasm: cd sflog && npx tree-sitter build --wasm && node ../scripts/copyFile.mjs tree-sitter-sflog.wasm ../docs/playground/tree-sitter-sflog.wasm && node ../scripts/copyFile.mjs tree-sitter-sflog.wasm ../bindings/web/tree-sitter-sflog.wasm
scripts.build-docs: node scripts/copyFile.mjs node_modules/web-tree-sitter/web-tree-sitter.js docs/playground/web-tree-sitter.js && node scripts/copyFile.mjs node_modules/web-tree-sitter/web-tree-sitter.wasm docs/playground/web-tree-sitter.wasm
scripts.test-load: npm run test-load-rust && npm run test-load-node && npm run test-load-web && npm run test-load-python
scripts.test: npm run test-apex && npm run test-soql && npm run test-sosl && npm run test-sflog && npm run test-load
